title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description: Company descriptionTradeAir (IFSC) is an IFSCA-registered broker-dealer and fund management entity in GIFT City, trading on NSE IX and India INX.Role descriptionYou will build and run our trading infrastructure and mid- and back-office systems, and act as our CISO. We want someone who understands networks, systems and financial markets, and can show what they have built.• Build and run trading infrastructure, including exchange connectivity to NSE IX and India INX.• Set up access to international exchanges and brokers, such as CME via its Aurora data centre.• Run data-centre and colocation environments, and design the network and server room for our new GIFT City office.• Manage firewalls, VPN, leased lines, access control (with MFA) and separation between fund and broking teams.• Support back-office, risk, reconciliation, email, user accounts and backups.• Manage telecom, exchange, colocation and hardware vendors.• Keep network diagrams, the asset inventory and DR drills current.• As CISO, own the cybersecurity policy, VAPT and audits, incident response, regulatory reporting, and Board reporting on cyber risk.Qualifications• At least 3 years of hands-on network, systems or infrastructure work.• Hands-on experience with routing and switching, firewalls, and Linux and Windows servers.• Working knowledge of MFA, patching, logging, backups and incident response.• Interest in financial markets and a basic understanding of order and market-data flow.• Projects you can demonstrate.• Able to work on site in GIFT City, Gandhinagar.Good to have: experience at a broker, exchange member, prop firm, bank or fund; exposure to CME, SGX or FIX connectivity, market-data feeds or colocation; VAPT, cyber audits or regulatory cybersecurity frameworks; Python or Bash scripting; CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Linux, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or ISO 27001.How to apply: please apply through our careers page at tradeair.in/careers/it-infrastructure-engineer. Applications are reviewed only through the careers page.
